# PR #2298: Patch: the card-token pick shows the cards it can unlock, with the deck builder's search, and asks before it spends the token

Closes #2251

## What changed

The shop's card-token pick is now the deck builder's browse pane over exactly the cards `unownedCards` returns, instead of a plain name list with one-click Pick buttons.

- [TokenPicker.tsx](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-2/_work/_temp/work/item-2251/apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.tsx): `TokenBody` holds filter/sort/detail/confirm state and renders `CardBrowser` (search, cost, type, rarity, set chips; no owned toggle) wrapped in `CardDefsProvider`, plus the deckbuilder.css import. Opening a face shows its `CardDetail` with an Unlock button (`token-card-pick-<id>`, disabled with 0 tokens); Unlock opens an `alertdialog` confirm naming the card ("Unlock {name}? This spends 1 card token."); Confirm calls the untouched `pickCard` once and closes dialog + detail, Cancel sends nothing. With 0 tokens the pool still browses and a hint line says a full bar pays a token. `pickCard`, the bars, and the `tokenError`-via-`t()` refusal path are byte-identical in behavior.
- [shop.ts](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-2/_work/_temp/work/item-2251/apps/web/src/shop/shop.ts): new pure `tokenPoolIds(unowned, catalog, filter, sort)` helper and `cardConfirm`/`cardCancel`/`cardDialog`/`cardHint` test ids; `cardPick`/`cardNone`/`heldCard` unchanged.
- [shop.css](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-2/_work/_temp/work/item-2251/apps/web/src/shop/shop.css): `.token-confirm` dialog in the token row's border style, `.token-confirm__actions` button row, and `.token-panel`-scoped browse fit (deckbuilder.css itself untouched).
- [zh-CN.json](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-2/_work/_temp/work/item-2251/apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json): `Unlock`, `Unlock {name}? This spends 1 card token.`, `A full card token bar pays a card token.`
- [45-economy-loop.cy.ts](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-2/_work/_temp/work/item-2251/e2e/cypress/e2e/45-economy-loop.cy.ts) + [testids.ts](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-2/_work/_temp/work/item-2251/e2e/support/testids.ts): `redeemACardToken` now reads the picked id from the pool grid (`card-pool-<id>`), clicks face → Unlock → Confirm; new `TOKEN_CARD_CONFIRM`/`TOKEN_CARD_CANCEL`/`TOKEN_POOL_CARDS` exports.

## How it was tested

- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/shop/TokenPicker.test.tsx`: **19/19 pass** (17s). Covers the six planned cases: pool faces exactly `unownedCards` + search narrows to the card; detail → Unlock → Cancel sends zero `redeem-card` requests; Confirm sends one `{cardId}` and the card leaves the pool with held count dropping; zero-token pool browses with Unlock disabled + hint; refusal shows the server's words with pool and held count unchanged; plus `tokenPoolIds` deck-builder sort order.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`: **6/6 pass**, including the R711000 every-`t()`-has-zh-entry scan and parameter-token check for the three new sentences.

- The stubbed collection owns every catalog card but `core-002`/`core-003`, so each mount renders a few faces instead of ~750.
